articles.title: Bitcoin Core changes security rules as AI makes finding code bugs dangerously easy
articles.snippet: Developers merged a policy change that ends the months-long embargo for flaws a chatbot could rediscover, after a summer in which AI found hundreds of bitcoin bugs before the humans did.

articles.title: Polymarket has reportedly fired its marketing chief, also a close friend of the CEO
articles.snippet: Matthew Modabber was reportedly ousted after an internal probe of several instances of misconduct, according to the New York Post.

articles.title: Bitcoin Core changes security policy as AI makes bugs easier to find
articles.snippet: Bitcoin Core says keeping certain vulnerabilities secret no longer offers much protection in the wake of AI-assisted bug hunting.

articles.title: Google Quietly Updates Privacy Policy to Let Gmail and Photos Data Feed Ads
articles.snippet: A policy change effective Oct. 16 carves out an exception to Google’s long-standing pledge—letting connected Gmail, Drive, and Photos data personalize ads through its Personal Intelligence AI features.

articles.title: How I Vibe Coded My Smart TV—And Claude Killed It
articles.snippet: Vibe coding your TV is impressive. Doing it without knowing exactly what you're touching is how you lose a rooted LG set and get a very sincere apology from an AI.
